segments.he: הַתְּפִלָּה שֶׁהִיא לְצרֶךְ נִשְׁמָתוֹ הִיא לְמַעְלָה מֵהַתּוֹרָה
segments.en: For this is the essence of mishpat: that a person must judge himself always — how it is fitting for him to conduct himself each day, and especially when he comes to a test and a trial that the inclination incites him to some desire or bad character trait. There the essence of mishpat is to judge oneself whether it is thus fitting for him to act. And the primary test and trial is in the desire for licentiousness, which is the ra hakolel [encompassing evil] — and there is the essence of mishpat, where a person must greatly fear Hashem's judgment and verdict and judge himself personally and flee from the transgression. As it is written: "Consider the loss of a mitzvah against its reward, and the reward of a transgression against its loss" [Avos 2:1] and: "I considered my ways" [Tehillim 119:59]. And as Rabbainu of blessed memory taught: a person must have yishuv hada'as [settled mind] — to settle oneself well as to the purpose of all the desires. And all of this is the aspect of mishpat described above, whose essence is in this desire. And Yosef merited the aspect of complete mishpat, through which he stood firm in the test.

segments.he: אֲבָל עִקַּר הַתְּפִלָּה הַשְּׁלֵמָה הִיא כְּשֶׁאָדָם מִתְפַּלֵּל רַק עַל צָרְכֵי נִשְׁמָתוֹ בְּעַצְמוֹ דְּהַיְנוּ שֶׁכָּל תְּפִלּוֹתָיו לִזְכּוֹת לְיִרְאַת ד' וַעֲבוֹדָתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ. כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם אַחַת שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאֵת ד' אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית ד' כָּל יְמֵי חַיַּי וְכוּ' וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב רַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה (בְּסִימָן י"ד) עַל מַאֲמַר רַבָּה בַּר בַּר חָנָה ושקלית לְסַלְתָּאִי ואנחיה בְּכַוְתָּא דִּרְקִיעַ עַיֵּן שָׁם.
segments.en: The general principle is that there is absolutely no despair in the world. Even if a person is as he is — as long as he still remembers Hashem and has the will to return to Him, even if it has been a long time since he has longed to return to Him yet has still not merited teshuvah — on the contrary, he may have caused further damage and added sin upon transgression, Heaven forbid — even so, let him strengthen himself in the will more and more. And let him accustom himself at every moment to long and yearn for Hashem always at every time. And through this he will certainly in the end merit to emerge from his folly and will certainly merit complete teshuvah without doubt.

segments.he: וּתְפִלָּה כָּזאת אֵינוֹ טְפֵלָה לַתּוֹרָה. אַדְּרַבָּא תְּפִלָּה כָּזאת הִיא עִקַּר קִיּוּם הַתּוֹרָה. מֵאַחַר שֶׁמְּבַקֵּשׁ רַק לְקַיֵּם אֶת הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁזֶּה עִקַּר שְׁלֵמוּת הַתּוֹרָה. כִּי לא הַמִּדְרָשׁ הוּא הָעִקָּר אֶלָּא הַמַּעֲשֶׂה. וְזֶה בְּחִינַת אִשָּׁה יִרְאַת ד' הִיא תִתְהַלָּל. הַיְנוּ הַתְּפִלָּה שֶׁהִיא בְּחִינַת אֵשֶׁת חַיִל כְּשֶׁהִוא בִּשְׁבִיל יִרְאַת ד' לִזְכּוֹת לְיִרְאָתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ הִיא תִתְהַלָּל. כִּי זֶה עִקַּר שְׁלֵמוּת הַתְּפִלָּה.
segments.en: And this path is a good and correct counsel for every person in the world, from the greatest to the smallest — whether a very great Tzaddik or a truly upright person who needs to ascend from level to level ever higher; or people of very low standing; or even those lying in the lowest depths, steeped in very bad deeds — even so, through the aspect of will, everyone can ascend from the very lowest rung to the very highest heights. And it is impossible to fully explain in writing the very great value of holy will and longing, as we have understood from the words of our holy Rabbainu of blessed memory — as we merited to hear from his own holy mouth. For in writing it is impossible to explain even the edge of even one part in a thousand. And he already revealed many sublime Torah teachings on this which have already been printed. But we understood even more from his holy mouth and from his holy movements and his wondrous intimations when he spoke of this many many times. And every person, according to who he is, must greatly accustom himself in this — to long and yearn always for Hashem with a strong and firm will. And this matter can certainly be fulfilled by every person, even the humblest of the humble — and the evil inclination cannot disrupt or contradict this counsel in any way for one who wishes to fulfil it. For while the evil inclination can overpower against all other matters and counsels in the world — preventing a person from fulfilling them — the will alone it cannot contradict in any manner. For however things are: "I want to return to Hashem with a strong will" — for who is the fool and madman who would not want the true and eternal good? Only it is hard for him to overpower what he needs to overpower. But in any case the will of all Yisrael who believe in Hashem is certainly very very strong to return to Him — only because they do not know the value of the will itself, that the will itself is very good — when they see that they have willed with a strong will many times yet still have not merited the service of Hashem and have also caused some further damage, they despair within themselves and forget to yearn further, until the will becomes concealed from them. And in truth this flaw is the hardest of all. For however things are — let one not release the will, nor abandon and forsake it. On the contrary, let one accustom oneself to long and yearn each time more and more with an ever stronger will for Hashem — for this will itself is very good and through it one can merit complete teshuvah in truth and ascend to all the levels of holiness.

segments.he: וְזאת הַתְּפִלָּה הִיא שָׁוָה עִם הַתּוֹרָה וְגָבוֹהַּ מִמֶּנָּה. כִּי עִקַּר הַכַּוָּנָה בְּלִמּוּד הַתּוֹרָה הוּא לְקַיֵּם אֶת הַתּוֹרָה. כִּי לא הַמִּדְרָשׁ הוּא הָעִקָּר אֶלָּא הַמַּעֲשֶׂה. וְזֶהוּ כַּוָּנָתוֹ בִּתְפִלָּתוֹ שֶׁמְּבַקֵּשׁ לְיִרְאָה אֶת ד' וּלְקַיֵּם אֶת הַתּוֹרָה. נִמְצָא שֶׁהַתּוֹרָה וְהַתְּפִלָּה שְׁנֵיהֶם שָׁוִים בְּקוֹמָתָם. וְאַף גַּם הַתְּפִלָּה גָּבוֹהַּ יוֹתֵר.
segments.en: Even though we have been crying and beseeching for so many years to return to the Land of Yisrael and we are still far from there — even so, no prayer and no cry is ever lost, even of the humblest of the humble. For with every cry and prayer one conquers some portion or point of the Land of Yisrael, until in its time He will hasten it — all the points we have conquered through our prayers will be gathered together and we will return to the Land of Yisrael. This is similar to what Rabbainu of blessed memory wrote on the teaching of Rabbah bar bar Channah [Likutay Moharan I:2]. And even one who is very flawed and whose cry and prayer have no power to conquer any point or portion of the Land of Yisrael — even so his cry accomplishes a great deal. For his cry when he prays to return to our land is in the aspect of a mecha'ah [legal protest] as explained in the law of chezkas karka'os [presumptive title to land] — that as long as one protests, the presumptive title of the holder has no effect at all.

segments.he: בִּבְחִינַת אֵשֶׁת חַיִל עֲטֶרֶת בַּעְלָהּ. בְּחִינַת רֵאשִׁית חָכְמָה יִרְאַת ד'. דְּהַיְנוּ הַתְּפִלָּה שֶׁהִיא בְּחִינַת אִשָּׁה יִרְאַת ד'. דְּהַיְנוּ מַה שֶּׁמִּתְפַּלֵּל עַל הַיִּרְאָה הִיא רֵאשִׁית חָכְמָה כִּי הוּא לְמַעְלָה מֵהַחָכְמָה שֶׁהִיא הַתּוֹרָה. כִּי תְּפִלָּה כָּזאת הִיא עִקַּר קִיּוּם הַתּוֹרָה. כִּי עִקַּר הַתּוֹרָה הִיא הַמַּעֲשֶׂה שֶׁזּוֹכִין עַל יְדֵי תְּפִלָּה זאת. כִּי לא הַמִּדְרָשׁ הוּא הָעִקָּר וְכוּ' כַּנַּ"ל כִּי הַכּל בִּידֵי שָׁמַיִם שֶׁהוּא הַתּוֹרָה בְּחִינַת זְעֵיר אַנְפִּין שֶׁנִּקְרָא שָׁמַיִם כַּיָּדוּעַ חוּץ מִיִּרְאַת שָׁמַיִם אֲבָל עַל יְדֵי תְּפִלָּה יְכוֹלִין לִזְכּוֹת לְיִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת כָּל סֵפֶר תְּהִלִּים שֶׁיָּסַד דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם שֶׁכֻּלּוֹ תְּפִלּוֹת לִזְכּוֹת לְיִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם וְלַעֲבוֹדָתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ כַּאֲשֶׁר יְבאַר לְפָנֵינוּ בְּעֶזְרַת ה'. (שָׁם אוֹת ד):
segments.en: Therefore, even though they have seized from us the Land of Yisrael which is our land and inheritance, and we have no power to extract it from them because of the damage of our evil deeds — even so we pray and cry out each time, and especially on Rosh HaShanah, that the Land of Yisrael is ours. For it is our inheritance from our ancestors and ultimately we will extract it from their hands. And through this we make a mecha'ah against the Sitra Achra, so they not delude themselves that the Land of Yisrael will remain in their hands forever — for their claim carries no weight, since we protest against them by crying out and publicizing each time, especially on Rosh HaShanah, before all those on high and below that the Land of Yisrael is ours from our ancestors. And ultimately we will extract it from their hands. And from this every person can derive hints for himself to strengthen himself each time in prayer and supplication and crying out to Hashem, whatever the situation — even if whatever comes upon him passes. For even if one sees that one's prayer has not accomplished anything, Heaven forbid, and the evil intensifies against one further — even so, let one know and believe that one's prayer and cry accomplishes much. For in any case one's prayer and cry is in the aspect of the mecha'ah described above — so that the Sitra Achra cannot establish itself in one's portion of the Land of Yisrael by any means, since a presumptive title has no effect when there is a protest against it.

aligned_segments.he: נִמְצָא שֶׁהַתּוֹרָה וְהַתְּפִלָּה שְׁנֵיהֶם שָׁוִים בְּקוֹמָתָם. וְאַף גַּם הַתְּפִלָּה גָּבוֹהַּ יוֹתֵר.
aligned_segments.en: For his cry when he prays to return to our land is in the aspect of a mecha'ah [legal protest] as explained in the law of chezkas karka'os [presumptive title to land] — that as long as one protests, the presumptive title of the holder has no effect at all.

aligned_segments.he: בִּבְחִינַת אֵשֶׁת חַיִל עֲטֶרֶת בַּעְלָהּ.
aligned_segments.en: Therefore, even though they have seized from us the Land of Yisrael which is our land and inheritance, and we have no power to extract it from them because of the damage of our evil deeds — even so we pray and cry out each time, and especially on Rosh HaShanah, that the Land of Yisrael is ours.

aligned_segments.he: בְּחִינַת רֵאשִׁית חָכְמָה יִרְאַת ד'.
aligned_segments.en: For it is our inheritance from our ancestors and ultimately we will extract it from their hands.

aligned_segments.he: דְּהַיְנוּ הַתְּפִלָּה שֶׁהִיא בְּחִינַת אִשָּׁה יִרְאַת ד'.
aligned_segments.en: And through this we make a mecha'ah against the Sitra Achra, so they not delude themselves that the Land of Yisrael will remain in their hands forever — for their claim carries no weight, since we protest against them by crying out and publicizing each time, especially on Rosh HaShanah, before all those on high and below that the Land of Yisrael is ours from our ancestors.

aligned_segments.he: דְּהַיְנוּ מַה שֶּׁמִּתְפַּלֵּל עַל הַיִּרְאָה הִיא רֵאשִׁית חָכְמָה כִּי הוּא לְמַעְלָה מֵהַחָכְמָה שֶׁהִיא הַתּוֹרָה.
aligned_segments.en: And ultimately we will extract it from their hands.

aligned_segments.he: כִּי תְּפִלָּה כָּזאת הִיא עִקַּר קִיּוּם הַתּוֹרָה.
aligned_segments.en: And from this every person can derive hints for himself to strengthen himself each time in prayer and supplication and crying out to Hashem, whatever the situation — even if whatever comes upon him passes.

aligned_segments.he: כִּי עִקַּר הַתּוֹרָה הִיא הַמַּעֲשֶׂה שֶׁזּוֹכִין עַל יְדֵי תְּפִלָּה זאת.
aligned_segments.en: For even if one sees that one's prayer has not accomplished anything, Heaven forbid, and the evil intensifies against one further — even so, let one know and believe that one's prayer and cry accomplishes much.

aligned_segments.he: כִּי לא הַמִּדְרָשׁ הוּא הָעִקָּר וְכוּ' כַּנַּ"ל כִּי הַכּל בִּידֵי שָׁמַיִם שֶׁהוּא הַתּוֹרָה בְּחִינַת זְעֵיר אַנְפִּין שֶׁנִּקְרָא שָׁמַיִם כַּיָּדוּעַ חוּץ מִיִּרְאַת שָׁמַיִם אֲבָל עַל יְדֵי תְּפִלָּה יְכוֹלִין לִזְכּוֹת לְיִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת כָּל סֵפֶר תְּהִלִּים שֶׁיָּסַד דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם שֶׁכֻּלּוֹ תְּפִלּוֹת לִזְכּוֹת לְיִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם וְלַעֲבוֹדָתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ כַּאֲשֶׁר יְבאַר לְפָנֵינוּ בְּעֶזְרַת ה'. (שָׁם אוֹת ד):
aligned_segments.en: For in any case one's prayer and cry is in the aspect of the mecha'ah described above — so that the Sitra Achra cannot establish itself in one's portion of the Land of Yisrael by any means, since a presumptive title has no effect when there is a protest against it.
